dimension_grades.evidence: The draft jumps directly to the root cause with no description of any wrong theories or false leads pursued during the investigation.
The draft uses passive/collective framing ('the issue turned out to be') and never has the author take personal ownership of a mistake or misjudgment.
No time spent on wrong paths is mentioned; the only time reference is 'several weeks' of memory growth, not time wasted on incorrect hypotheses.
The tone is neutral and clinical throughout, with no self-deprecating or wry humor about mistakes made.
The root cause is stated in the second section ('The issue turned out to be an event listener leak') with no prior presentation of ambiguous evidence or initial misreadings.
The 'Investigation Methodology' section lists steps 1–4 as a retrospective numbered list, not an incremental unfolding of clues with building understanding.
The root cause is revealed in the 'Root Cause' section before any investigation narrative, so there is no sustained tension preceding it.
The draft contains no mention of the author's emotional state — no frustration, surprise, or relief — at any point during the investigation.
Takeaways like 'Always monitor your memory usage in production' and 'Be disciplined about removing listeners' are general principles, not specific behavior changes the author now follows.
The first takeaway is literally 'Always monitor your memory usage in production' — classic generic advice that is presented earnestly rather than acknowledged and moved past.
Takeaways are listed as abstract bullet points with no explicit callback to a specific moment in the narrative where the lesson was learned.
The conclusion says 'I hope this walkthrough helps you the next time you're facing a similar issue,' adopting a teacher-to-student framing rather than peer-to-peer.
The draft contains exactly two focused code snippets — the buggy version and the fixed version — which is appropriately minimal.
The critical line in the buggy snippet is marked with '// Bug: handler is never removed when this path executes', directing the reader's attention.
Both the problematic code and the fixed code are shown in separate snippets, clearly illustrating the transformation.

Before the first snippet, the prose explains 'Each incoming request registered a listener on a shared EventEmitter instance, but under a specific error-handling path, the listener was never removed,' telling the reader what to look for.
No concrete sensory or environmental details appear — no time of day, no description of a dashboard view, no Slack message or similar grounding detail.
The draft names specific tools: Prometheus, Chrome DevTools, Node.js 18, and Express, rather than using generic descriptions.
The entire investigation is presented as a retrospective numbered list summary ('Here's the systematic approach we followed') rather than dramatized scenes with action.
